notes.title: Etrian Odyssey HD is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Venture into the unknown in Etrian Odyssey HD, now available for the first time on PC! 

[previewyoutube=RSeXc8JwwFw;full][/previewyoutube]

Purchase Etrian Odyssey HD before 6/14 to receive in-game character portraits of Joker from Persona 5 and Ringo from Soul Hackers 2! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43618251/1b75919acf6eb08000891a71d25e53dc92f96f53.png[/img]

Build a party of explorers from nine different character classes - Create a woodland Survivalist, shield-bearing Protector, whip-wielding Dark Hunter, and more. Scour through the dungeon's many layers and fend off the unknown to discover the truth behind the Yggdrasil Labyrinth.

Etrian Odyssey HD Features: [list]

[*] Newly remastered graphics, remastered soundtrack and quality of life improvements, including difficulty selection and save slots
[*] Easy access to the Monstrous Codex, quest log and skill tree
[*] Maximize your adventuring by optimizing your party, and choose the character classes that work for your playstyle.

[/list] 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1868180/Etrian_Odyssey_HD/]Etrian Odyssey HD is now available on Steam![/url]
